rate_items.basis: per month per $1,000 of outstanding insured debt

rate_table_note: Rate is in part 2760.0050, subpart 1, item A. Single premium rates come from the formula in item B and joint coverage is 167% of single; neither is published as a figure. Rates complying with the 2009 rules were required no later than January 1, 2010 (the date shown).
source_title: Minnesota Rules chapter 2760, Credit Life, Accident and Health Insurance (33 SR 1107)
summary: Rates in force: Minnesota's initial credit life prima facie rate in Minn. R. 2760.0050, $0.615 per month per $1,000 of outstanding insured debt on a single life, required no later than January 1, 2010. No adjustment bulletin under 2760.0080 was found.
